blurb: Guests board the Tahoe Gal, a historic paddle wheeler, for scenic cruises on Lake Tahoe including trips to Emerald Bay and along the North and West Shores. Cruises feature views of lakefront estates, hidden coves, Vikingsholm Castle, and Fannette Island. Some cruises offer chef-prepared meals and drinks for purchase.

quotes.author: Peggy S (TripAdvisor)
quotes.text: This was a perfect way to enjoy the lake. Took the Tahoe Gal over to Emerald Bay for a Sunday lunch cruise. The day was beautiful and the bay, beyond words. Enjoyed learning about the lake and the history of the area. The captain did a great job with all the information, however, the sound system could be improved. The food, albeit a bit pricey was good and the mixed drinks yum! The crew did a great job and were always smiling even though they were kept busy... Overall we loved it and would definitely do it again!!!

quotes.author: Melissa B (TripAdvisor)
quotes.text: We had the best time on the Happy Hour Cruise! The boat is charming and the views of the lake are stunning and beautiful! The staff were all incredibly friendly and accommodating from check in to the photo guy to the captain! We brought our own captain's hats to be goofy and the captain and staff got such a kick out of it that they let us get a look at the cockpit (is it a cockpit on a boat??) and pretend to drive! It was a fun, relaxing activity before going to dinner.
